exposure: Activity-based training (ABT) - quadrupedal (Quad or Q) stepping on a treadmill
Different ABT durations (none, daily for 8 weeks, once a week for 4 weeks, daily for final 4th week only)
outcome: EAS latency and amplitude during fecal expulsion
cohort: Six groups of male rats, including uninjured and spinal cord injured (SCI) animals, some of whom received activity-based training.
finding: Treadmill training normalized defecation amount, GC frequency, EAS latency and amplitude during fecal expulsion, and resting pressure in specific colorectum areas, with intermittent training groups showing results comparable to non-injured animals.
followup_time: 10 weeks (8 weeks of activity-based training starting 2 weeks post-SCI)
